entries.title: Job 27:1
segments: And Job again took up his parable, and said,

entries.title: Job 27:2
segments: As God liveth, who hath taken away my right, And the Almighty, who hath vexed my soul:

entries.title: Job 27:3
segments: (For my life is yet whole in me, And the spirit of God is in my nostrils);

entries.title: Job 27:4
segments: Surely my lips shall not speak unrighteousness, Neither shall my tongue utter deceit.

entries.title: Job 27:5
segments: Far be it from me that I should justify you: Till I die I will not put away mine integrity from me.

entries.title: Job 27:6
segments: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: My heart shall not reproach [me] so long as I live.

entries.title: Job 27:7
segments: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, And let him that riseth up against me be as the unrighteous.

entries.title: Job 27:8
segments: For what is the hope of the godless, though he get him gain, When God taketh away his soul?

entries.title: Job 27:9
segments: Will God hear his cry, When trouble cometh upon him?

entries.title: Job 27:10
segments: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, And call upon God at all times?

entries.title: Job 27:11
segments: I will teach you concerning the hand of God; That which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.

entries.title: Job 27:12
segments: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; Why then are ye become altogether vain?

entries.title: Job 27:13
segments: This is the portion of a wicked man with God, And the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty:

entries.title: Job 27:14
segments: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword; And his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.

entries.title: Job 27:15
segments: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death, And his widows shall make no lamentation.

entries.title: Job 27:16
segments: Though he heap up silver as the dust, And prepare raiment as the clay;

entries.title: Job 27:17
segments: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, And the innocent shall divide the silver.

entries.title: Job 27:18
segments: He buildeth his house as the moth, And as a booth which the keeper maketh.

entries.title: Job 27:19
segments: He lieth down rich, but he shall not be gathered [to his fathers]; He openeth his eyes, and he is not.

entries.title: Job 27:20
segments: Terrors overtake him like waters; A tempest stealeth him away in the night.

entries.title: Job 27:21
segments: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth; And it sweepeth him out of his place.

entries.title: Job 27:22
segments: For [God] shall hurl at him, and not spare: He would fain flee out of his hand.

entries.title: Job 27:23
segments: Men shall clap their hands at him, And shall hiss him out of his place.
